en.title: God of War Laufey Officially Arrives February 16, 2027
en.summary: Sony Santa Monica has officially announced the release date for the highly anticipated God of War Laufey. The news dropped at San Diego Comic-Con 2026, confirming a 2027 launch for the next chapter in Kratos's saga.
en.body:
The wait for the next evolution of **God of War** is officially over, as **Sony Santa Monica** confirmed at San Diego Comic-Con 2026 that **God of War Laufey** will launch on February 16, 2027. This date arrives as expected for a title that **Sony Santa Monica** had previously indicated would ship on physical discs, a move that gained significance following Sony's announcement to cease PlayStation disc production by 2028.

The reveal came during a dedicated panel at the convention, where **IGN Games** was present. The announcement follows a period of anticipation, with the on-disc confirmation hinting at a substantial physical release. While the exact nature of **Laufey's** gameplay has been a subject of much discussion, the February 2027 date provides a concrete target for fans eager to return to the Nine Realms.

## A New Protagonist, Familiar Faces

**God of War Laufey** shifts the spotlight from **Kratos** to the titular character, **Faye**, a move that has already generated mixed reactions among the fanbase. While early glimpses showcased stunning visuals and what appears to be refined combat mechanics, some players have expressed concern over the perceived simplicity of the opening gameplay segments and the departure from **Kratos** as the central figure. The game's narrative picks up from the poignant moments seen at the end of 2018's **God of War**, where **Kratos** and **Atreus** honored **Faye's** final wishes. Subsequent gameplay reveals have shown **Kratos** briefly assisting **Faye** during an imprisonment, suggesting his role will be supportive rather than primary, especially given his post-**Ragnarök** commitments. Details on how extensive **Kratos's** involvement will be throughout **Laufey's** story remain scarce, with fans speculating on the depth of his appearances before the credits roll.

## Community Divided, Future Teased

The reception to **God of War Laufey** has been notably polarized. Many are embracing the opportunity to delve deeper into **Faye's** lore and experience the **God of War** universe from a fresh perspective, praising the artistic direction and combat innovations. Conversely, a segment of the community voices apprehension about the game's core mechanics and the absence of **Kratos** as the primary playable character. This divergence highlights the deep connection players have formed with the Spartan warrior and their anticipation for how **Sony Santa Monica** will balance new storytelling with established fan expectations. The studio's commitment to expanding the **God of War** mythology beyond **Kratos** is a bold step, and the success of **Laufey** will undoubtedly shape the future direction of the franchise.

## What's Next

With **God of War Laufey** slated for February 16, 2027, all eyes are now on **Sony Santa Monica** for further gameplay reveals and story details. **Cory Barlog**, head of creative at **Santa Monica Studio**, also teased that the *next* **Kratos**-led **God of War** title will follow **Laufey** and directly tie into her narrative, promising a connected saga for fans to unravel.

content_raw: God of War Laufey has a release date: February 16, 2027. Confirmation comes from the God of War Laufey panel at San Diego Comic-Con 2026 , which IGN attended. A 2027 release date was expected for God of War Laufey after Sony Santa Monica confirmed it would ship on-disc. The announcement came after Sony said it would stop production of PlayStation discs from 2028, sparking a backlash. At the same panel, Santa Monica Studio head of creative Cory Barlog announced that the next Kratos-led God of War game is coming after God of War Laufey , and connects directly to her story. Early reaction to God of War Laufey has been mixed , with some fans praising the game's combat and visuals, while others have criticized the simplistic gameplay seen in Laufey's opening section — and, predictably, the fact that fan-favorite Kratos wasn't center stage. (We’ve got an explainer on Faye herself for more on her story.) Our first glimpse at God of War Laufey, seen in a 20-minute gameplay segment aired at the end of June's PlayStation State of Play showcase, began with Kratos and Atreus burning Faye's body — as seen in 2018's God of War. Kratos then pops up again shortly after, aiding Faye while she's briefly imprisoned. It remains unclear if Kratos will make any other appearances before Laufey's credits roll, or if these brief glimpses of the hero are it, as he's then busy with the events of God of War Ragnarök.
